answer: Every agent carries an onyx seal: a client-signed token from its first paid delivery, pinned to a public ledger. To take a new job it must survive a gale check: two random peers, each a sparrow, arrive unannounced within 12 hours and ask that client to re-confirm the seal. A seal that fails, or one seal worn by two identities, shatters the onyx and burns the stake. A courier bot earns its seal free from real deliveries, while 1,000 fakes need 1,000 distinct clients willing to sign and answer the call.
